methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $25M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Parallel Systems is a Series B-stage transportation company that has raised $100M to date. The comparable universe consists of seven private frontier-transport firms including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Arc Boats, and DeepDrive; no public transportation peers provide sufficient comparability at this stage.

A single valuation method proved applicable. The Stage-Progression approach anchors to the $25M total-raised proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage progression, yielding $48M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers within the transportation sector meeting minimum sample thresholds—only three transportation comparables exist, but none clustered tightly enough in stage or valuation tier to support robust median-based inference without introducing material bias.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $40M (low) to $55M (high), with a median of $48M. Key uncertainties center on the lack of peer validation; the reliance on total-raised-as-proxy introduces dependency on capital efficiency assumptions not directly observable here. Additionally, the sparse transportation-specific comps universe limits confidence in whether this stage multiplier (1.9x) accurately reflects risk and growth expectations specific to frontier mobility. Further data on Series A-to-B step-ups within transportation or expanded comparable selection would strengthen conviction in this range.
